notes.title: BALLS TO THE WALL MEGA UPDATE IS LIVE !!!!!!
notes.notes:
BALLISTIC v1.4 UPDATE
Balls to the Wall!

- Massive game-wide visual overhaul

- Several levels revamped from the ground up for more engaging gameplay

- Merged all abilities into hardcore difficulty and removed distinction between 
   difficulty levels.

- Optimization updates

- AI improvements

- Partial controller support added

- Fixed physics depenetration glitches

- fixed glitches some users experienced when attempting to change 
  resolution

- New tutorial video included

- Numerous other bug fixes and optimizations, like really, really wicked 
  numerous.

notes.title: NEW FEATURES COMING SOON!
notes.notes: With more and more people enjoying Ballistic, we're looking into adding some new features to the game and to the Steam side of things.  To start, we're going to implement game controller support, and we will be adding Steam trading cards as well. While we're exploring more ideas, we'd love to hear from you guys as well.  Feedback and suggestions are always welcome. And also, we just want to give a BIG thanks to everyone who's bought the game so far.  You guys are awesome, and we hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update coming tonight!
notes.notes:
HUGE THANKS to everyone who bought the game so far! You guys are awesome.

Tonight, we will have an update rolling out that'll include a few fixes and improvements including:

-Normcore and Hardcore modes. 
Normcore will have air control, and jump and megadrive will not be mutually exclusive. This allows for more dynamic movement and new angles of attack. Feel free to switch difficulties at any time without losing progress.

-UI updates
  -Detailed gameplay instructions are now visible up front on the main menu.
  -HUD reflects jump and megadrive IDs separately.

-Hummingboys no longer fall through their seats.

-VR headsets no longer hijack the game.
